info.title: US FDA Recalls & Safety Monitor (Food, Drug & Devices)
info.description:
Monitors and enriches official U.S. FDA enforcement recall reports across Food, Drugs, and Medical Devices via openFDA. Calculates hazard severity scores (0-100) and generates Markdown legal briefs for Product Liability law firms and retail compliance.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (US FDA Recalls & Safety Monitor (Food, Drug & Devices))
- **Target B2B Buyers:** Pharmaceutical Compliance Teams, Hospital Pharmacies, Retail Supply Chains, and InsurTech Underwriters.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`US FDA Enforcement Recall Extracted`).
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Medical` | Zyla API Hub `Healthcare`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** fda-recalls, openfda, drug-safety, medical-device-recalls, food-safety, supply-chain-risk, pharmacovigilance.

import httpx

url = "https://b2b-quant-rapidapi-gateway.jesleytassili.workers.dev/v1/us-fda-recalls-safety-monitor"
payload = {
    "domain": "food",
    "classification": "ALL",
    "keyword": "",
    "state": "",
    "maxResults": 15
}
headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "X-RapidAPI-Host": "us-fda-recalls-safety-monitor.p.rapidapi.com",
    "X-RapidAPI-Key": "<YOUR_RAPIDAPI_OR_ZYLA_KEY>",
}

with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
    response = client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.json())

UsFdaRecallsSafetyMonitorRequest.title: US FDA Recalls & Safety Monitor (Food, Drug & Devices) Request Schema
UsFdaRecallsSafetyMonitorRequest.description: Configure the FDA regulatory domain, hazard classification filter, search keywords, and US state filter to extract enriched FDA recall intelligence.

domain.title: FDA Regulatory Domain
domain.description: Select the FDA enforcement category to monitor: food, drug, or device.

classification.title: Hazard Classification
classification.description: Filter recalls by FDA hazard severity class (Class I = highest life-threatening risk, Class II = moderate/reversible risk, Class III = low risk).

keyword.title: Search Keyword (Optional)
keyword.description: Optional search keyword in reason_for_recall or product_description (e.g., 'salmonella', 'listeria', 'undeclared', 'pacemaker').

state.title: US State Code (Optional)
state.description: Optional 2-letter US State of recalling firm (e.g., 'CA', 'NY', 'TX', 'FL').

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of recall enforcement records to fetch (1 to 200).

UsFdaRecallsSafetyMonitorRecord.title: US FDA Recalls & Safety Monitor (Food, Drug & Devices) Output Record
UsFdaRecallsSafetyMonitorRecord.description: Enriched B2B dataset item returned by `us-fda-recalls-safety-monitor`.

recallNumber.title: Recall Number
recallNumber.description: Official FDA recall event or enforcement number.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: FDA hazard severity class (Class I, Class II, Class III).

severityScore.title: Severity Score (0-100)
severityScore.description: Quantitative risk score based on hazard class, recall status, and nationwide distribution.

recallingFirm.title: Recalling Firm
recallingFirm.description: Manufacturer, distributor, or firm initiating the recall.

state.title: State
state.description: 2-letter US State code of the recalling firm.

status.title: Recall Status
status.description: Current enforcement status (Ongoing, Completed, Terminated, Pending).

reasonForRecall.title: Reason for Recall
reasonForRecall.description: Official FDA summary of the defect, contamination, or safety hazard.

productDescription.title: Product Description
productDescription.description: Detailed description of the recalled product, packaging, and brand.

markdownLegalBrief.title: Markdown Legal & Compliance Brief
markdownLegalBrief.description: Ready-to-use Markdown dossier for Product Liability litigation and supply chain QA.

quantScore.title: Quantitative Compliance & Opportunity Score (0-100)
quantScore.description: Normalized deterministic score from 0 to 100 generated by the quantitative engine.
